notes:
- Finds far more than email addresses: API keys and passwords, card numbers, IBANs, IP
  addresses, phone numbers, links that carry a token, faces, and on a Mac QR codes and barcodes.
- Suggestions start as soon as an image opens. In Settings, Redaction, pick the kinds to hide
  every time without asking; faces and possible card numbers always wait for your review.
- Your own words: list names, companies or project codes in Settings, and VeilShot finds them
  too. "Hide everywhere" finds every other place the same text appears.
- Three new ways to hide: Pixelate, Fill to match (the area takes the colour around it) and
  Stand-in text (a neutral name@example.com in place of the real one). All of them replace
  the pixels for good.
- Copy and Export first tell you when suggestions are still unreviewed, with Review and Export
  anyway.
- VeilShot follows your system language, in 12 languages.
